findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Functional. This check treats a workflow ID in the current board snapshot as proof that its queued failure is still current. The board reuses check results for 60 seconds (`src/forge/board.py:104`), so a rerun started during that window leaves the failed occurrence in the snapshot. If the busy turn ends then, the pane submits the obsolete failure. The new test advances `FORGE_NOW` by a full minute before each response (`tests/test_mod_plugin.py:248`), so it does not cover this sequence.
findings.title: A queued CI failure is delivered when its rerun starts within the cache minute

why: On Windows the board's known issues miss problems kept in older merged pull requests, and the known-issues tests fail there, so the every-platform suite cannot pass
